system_prompt: Use the context in the left (first) and right (second) images to explain what the shared or similar visual feature listed below represents mathematically in each image. Answer "yes" if the feature has the same mathematical meaning in both images, or "no" if its meanings differ. Justify your judgment using evidence visible in the images. Return one English JSON object with exactly three string fields: mathematical_meanings (format: Left image: ... Right image: ...), same_mathematical_meanings ("yes" or "no"), and Rationales.
